effects.description: Gives the recipient a HP Shield. All damage the recipient takes will be subtracted from the Shield first, before their HP.Each Skill can only cast one Shield at a time on each recipient.

bio: Thiselle was not raised a warrior. Her noble family were blessed with the power to speak with animals, and cared for the forests and creatures on their lands; Thiselle only became an Invoker when poachers attacked. Her time tending the land is over – her time fighting to defend it has only just begun.
